tasks.label: Unit tests (dc-assistant container)
tasks.command: docker compose exec dc-assistant bash -lc "/opt/venv/bin/pip install -q pytest && cd /myapps && /opt/venv/bin/python -m pytest /app/tests/unit/ -q"

tasks.label: Unit tests (dc-assistant container, verbose)
tasks.command: docker compose exec dc-assistant bash -lc "/opt/venv/bin/pip install -q pytest && cd /myapps && /opt/venv/bin/python -m pytest /app/tests/unit/ -v"
